raw_text: The pre-fixe menu had some decent options, but the Shanghai low mein was just okay and a bit overpriced
The serving here is super speedy and efficient!

The dish, a simple yet satisfying preparation of chicken on rice with ginger, offered an unremarkable culinary experience that neither impressed nor disappointed the diner, adhering closely to expectations without venturing into the realms of exceptionalism or mediocrity
The fried shrimp wasn't particularly memorable, but it did the job as a quick snack
Thai ice tea is just okay, nothing special
The establishment exudes a rather unremarkable vibe, neither particularly inviting nor off-putting, which leaves patrons to focus more on the service and cuisine offered;
